name: core_List_Cursor_tail_at

name: core_List_IsSuffix_getLast
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ <:+ l₂) (hx : l₁ ≠ []), l₁.getLast hx = l₂.getLast ⋯

name: core_List_IsSuffix_le_count
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α}, l₁ <:+ l₂ → ∀ (a : α), List.count a l₂ - (l₂.length - l₁.length) ≤ List.count a l₁

name: core_List_MergeSort_Internal_splitInTwo_fst_le_splitInTwo_snd

name: core_List_Perm_append_left
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {t₁ t₂ : List α} (l : List α), t₁.Perm t₂ → (l ++ t₁).Perm (l ++ t₂)

name: core_List_apply_minOn_append_le_right
statement: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] {xs ys : List α} {f : α → β} (h : ys ≠ []), f (List.minOn f (xs ++ ys) ⋯) ≤ f (List.minOn f ys h)

name: core_List_attach_filterMap
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : α → Option β}, (List.filterMap f l).attach = List.filterMap (fun x => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => (f x).pbind fun b m => some ⟨b, ⋯⟩) l.attach

name: core_List_cons_merge_cons
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (s : α → α → Bool) (a b : α) (l r : List α), (a :: l).merge (b :: r) s = if s a b = true then a :: l.merge (b :: r) s else b :: (a :: l).merge r s

name: core_List_count_attachWith
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] {p : α → Prop} {l : List α} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → p a) {a : { x // p x }}, List.count a (l.attachWith p H) = List.count a.val l

name: core_List_filter_append_perm
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (p : α → Bool) (l : List α), (List.filter p l ++ List.filter (fun x => !p x) l).Perm l

name: core_List_findIdx_subtype
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → Bool} {g : α → Bool}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x), f ⟨x, h⟩ = g x) → List.findIdx f l = List.findIdx g l.unattach

name: core_List_foldlM_map
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {f : β₁ → β₂} {g : α → β₂ → m α} {l : List β₁} {init : α}, List.foldlM g init (List.map f l) = List.foldlM (fun x y => g x (f y)) init l

name: core_List_foldl_flatMap
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → List β} {g : γ → β → γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldl g init (List.flatMap f l) = List.foldl (fun acc x => List.foldl g acc (f x)) init l

name: core_List_foldrM_subtype
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → β → m β} {g : α → β → m β} {x : β}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x) (b : β), f ⟨x, h⟩ b = g x b) → List.foldrM f x l = List.foldrM g x l.unattach

name: core_List_foldrM_wfParam
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {xs : List α} {f : α → β → m β} {init : β}, List.foldrM f init (wfParam xs) = List.foldrM f init xs.attach.unattach

name: core_List_getElem_attach

name: core_List_getElem_maxIdxOn

name: core_List_getElem_set_ne

name: core_List_head_takeWhile

name: core_List_infix_filterMap_iff
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → Option β} {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β}, l₂ <:+: List.filterMap f l₁ ↔ ∃ l, l <:+: l₁ ∧ l₂ = List.filterMap f l

name: core_List_infix_map_iff
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β}, l₂ <:+: List.map f l₁ ↔ ∃ l, l <:+: l₁ ∧ l₂ = List.map f l

name: core_List_mapFinIdx_congr
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {xs ys : List α} (w : xs = ys) (f : (i : Nat) → α → i < xs.length → β), xs.mapFinIdx f = ys.mapFinIdx fun i a h => f i a ⋯

name: core_List_mergeSort_pair

name: core_List_minOn_cons
statement: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : LE β] [inst_1 : DecidableLE β] [Std.IsLinearPreorder β] {x : α} {xs : List α} {f : α → β}, List.minOn f (x :: xs) ⋯ = if h : xs = [] then x else minOn f x (List.minOn f xs h)
